description:
"Roar with bloodlust to fear nearby enemies for |cffffff4|r seconds, setting them Off Balance for |cffffff7|r seconds, and applying Major Cowardice and Maim for |cffffff14|r seconds. Grants you a stack of Blood Hunger.

Up to 12 nearby allies can activate the Feeding Frenzy synergy, which grants |cffffff6|r% damage done and Minor Force for |cffffff30|r seconds.

While slotted you gain Major Evasion and Minor Protection. Selecting this morph causes your Gnash to taunt enemies if cast while Bracing."
